title: NAILS check --json
description: Machine-readable check envelope (contract version 2): one document with schema_version, command, ok, and either data (readiness report (the checks, the effective configuration, the overlay targets and the NixOS profile); ok is whether the host is ready (a refused check is exit 4)) or error. The envelope frame and error body are strict; the data is this command's own payload. ok is true only when the exit code is 0 or 9.
